# Security policy

Please do not report security problems in public issues, discussions or pull
requests.

Report them privately through GitHub, in
[a security advisory for graphicle-ai/graphicle](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/security/advisories/new).
Use it for every repository of the graphicle-ai organisation, the Homebrew tap
included. Only the maintainers can read the report.

[SECURITY.md in graphicle-ai/graphicle](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
lists the supported versions, what to include in a report and what happens
next.
